page.notes: Printed lines are copied as read; the scan is slightly blurred in places. Doubtful: "Caluitium" (first letter and vowel), "columnitas" (word possibly different), "Concupiscentia niitur" (possibly "nititur"), "Confcientiae" and "Concupiscentiae" spelling as printed. The first column opens with the tail of an entry ("reptus 108.b"), and the bottom of the page is cut off where the last lines of the columns end. The small mark "§ 8" at bottom right is not clearly a page number or signature, so it is left out. The entry "28.b" at the top of the right column is a fragment of an entry continued from the previous page.
